events.label: Jump
events.description: Small pixel hero springs up off a grassy tile

events.label: Land
events.description: Small hero drops onto a grassy tile platform, kicking up dust

events.label: Coin pickup
events.description: Hero touches a spinning gold coin; it floats up and fades out

events.label: Hurt
events.description: Hero touches metal spikes, flashes red and is knocked back

events.label: Dash
events.description: Hero bursts forward through the air, leaving a trail of ghost images

events.label: UI click
events.description: Player presses the on-screen Reset coins button

events.label: Checkpoint
events.description: A grey flag on a pole turns bright and starts waving as the hero passes

events.label: Level complete
events.description: Hero reaches the exit door and a Level complete banner appears

events.label: Respawn
events.description: Hero blinks back into view at the last checkpoint after being hurt
